Car on the setup patch at 20 C garage temperature, fuel drained, driver ballast fitted, tyres at the setup-sheet pressure. Reading 43.1 mm.

state.measurement_report: Front wing left flap angle recorded at 14.2 degrees. Measured against the car's reference plane with the car on the setup pads at race ride height, fuel at 30 kg, tyres at working pressure, ambient 21 C. Ride height had been set beforehand using the Halvorsen HS-3 digital height stick zeroed on the pad plate. Value logged to setup sheet run 7.

rationale: The only instrument named (the height stick) was used to set ride height, not to obtain the flap angle, so the procedure for the named quantity lacks its instrument even though the reference plane and conditions are stated; instrument_not_stated is also first in the contract's priority order.

state.anomaly_note: Front-left ride height read 1.4 mm lower than the run sheet on the morning check. The height gauge had not been re-zeroed after the surface plate was moved last night; after zeroing, the reading matched the sheet. Cause: gauge zero drift, no change to the car.

rationale: The note concludes that the gauge zeroing, not the car, produced the deviation.

state.anomaly_note: Rear anti-roll bar stiffness measured about 6 percent below the drawing value on the rig. The bar was checked on the second rig with the same result, and its diameter measured under nominal along its full length. Conclusion: bar manufactured under size; quarantine the part.

rationale: The note concludes that the component itself is out of specification and rules out the rig.
The note is empty, so no attribution can be read.

state.anomaly_note: Rear left camber reads 0.4 deg more negative than the setup sheet value. The Corvin camber gauge was re-zeroed on the reference bar and the reading repeated three times within 0.02 deg, so the instrument is not the cause. On inspection the upper wishbone inboard bracket bush bore is visibly ovalised, and the camber shim pack on that corner was also found assembled one shim short after the overnight rebuild. Both contributed to the reading; bracket to be replaced and shim pack corrected before run 3.

rationale: The note concludes that two causes contributed, a worn bracket (part) and a shim-pack assembly condition (setup), and the contract's tie-break order lists part_attributed before setup_attributed; the gauge is explicitly ruled out, and a ruled-out cause is not an attribution.

state.specification_text: The mass of the car, including the driver in full racing apparel but without fuel, must not be less than the value in the series minimum weight table at any time during the event.

rationale: The limit constrains the weight of the car and driver, not a dimension, temperature, or pressure.

state.specification_text: With each tyre stabilised at the series reference temperature of 90 C and checked with the official bleed gauge, the starting pressure of every front tyre shall not be below the published compound minimum, and each rear tyre shall not be below its own published minimum.

rationale: The temperature figure is a measurement condition, not a limit placed on the tyre, so the first-limit rule does not reach it; the only constraint the text imposes is on tyre pressure.

rationale: The statement asserts that the measured gap is within the limit and that the assembly conforms, which is a conformance claim under the stated precedence.

rationale: The statement reports a reading and then proposes a re-measurement; no result against a limit is asserted, so the recommendation wins over the observation.

state.finding_statement: Plank thickness at the rear reference hole measured 8.6 mm with the depth micrometer after the session; the tolerance sheet lists a 9.0 mm minimum at that hole. Photographs and the raw reading are attached for the scrutineers' file.

rationale: The statement reports the measured value and quotes the limit side by side but never asserts that the plank is within or outside it, passes or fails, and proposes no action; the comparison of the two numbers is code's job, so the statement remains an observation.

rationale: The entry names one setup parameter (the front bar, symmetric on both sides) together with a part replacement, and the contract counts a parameter plus a part replacement as several changes even when the swap is like-for-like with settings carried over.

state.telemetry_summary: Run 8 summary. Against the run 5 baseline, T7 minimum ride height was lower and the rear brake peak at T1 was cooler. Against simulation model v12, the T3 apex speed matched within the model band. Traction out of T10 improved noticeably. Water and oil temperatures held flat for the full 18 laps.

rationale: Two comparative statements name their baseline (run 5, simulation model v12), but 'improved noticeably' for T10 traction identifies nothing it is compared with, and the contract requires every comparative statement to name its reference for baseline_named.
